title: Remove redundant marked Counter return moves and writes
body:
Remove redundant marked-Counter return work with one initial-ONE branch. Relative to Nick Petalas's PR6495 cached decrement (head9ba6f43b4d1da64e250f948a8e684011ef9fb0c6), a complete N>0 countdown saves an additional (reads,writes,moves)=(2ceil(N/2)+1,3,2ceil(N/2)+4), total4ceil(N/2)+8. N0 is unchanged. Its earlier N-read caching result is credited prior work.

The branch changes the first ONE to ZERO, steps right/reads the next symbol, sets finished only at RIGHT, and returns one step left. The initial-ZERO borrow path remains literal. PROOF.md proves complete allocated-bytearray/backing-length/head/finished equivalence, including padded and previously larger counters shrinking to1, and exact traffic by induction. It uses no numeric head, decoded cardinality, ripple length, new tape/alphabet or unbounded control. Constructor and disposal are retained.

The change is executed in the complete retained sign-address caller, with all Counter aliases, zero counters, construction, finally cleanup, unchanged arithmetic, payload and source-head returns paid in the full primary interval. With K=B(4(M−2)+M*1_{S>1}), P=1+B+2B*1_{M>2}+K and C=ceil(B/2)+2Bceil((M−2)/2)+Bceil((M−1)/2)+Kceil(S/2), the complete additional saving is (2C+P,3P,2C+4P). At (M,B,S)=(2,1,1), oldRWM(294,87,342) becomes(288,81,330):24 fewer operations, same four Counter allocations including two zero counters.

Evidence:810 complete countdowns/168579 paired steps, all literal intermediate states, protected input, full final/closed tapes and predicted totals pass. N covers0..255 plus2^k±1 for k8..12, padding0/1/4.252 actual full-source callers cover M2/3/4/5/8/9,B1/2/3,S1/2/3/4/7/8/9,two opaque payloads; actual output coordinates/bits, protected source/before/suffix tapes, Arena live ownership and closed Counter tapes pass. A separately written literal transition oracle imports no author/primary program and independently checks810 countdowns and252 caller-control cases. Root joins all810 RWM/final/closed states and252 deltas, allocation/positive/odd counts and payload SHAs. The two payload formulas are equal modulo2. Intermediate state hashes have different encodings, and no independent source-coordinate-hash agreement is claimed.

The oracle does not independently meter unchanged positive_extent/one_bit_suffix recognition, Count setup or ring/Arena/Unsigned arithmetic. Absolute complete totals are primary full-source replay evidence; independent coverage is the declared state/delta/inventory/payload projection. Numeric modulus/ring.one Word contents and every freed Arena word were not separately snapshotted; unchanged source operations follow from equal Counter exits and loop counts. No broader dirty-restoration claim is inferred.

All smoke/810/full252/strict normal/O runs pass with empty stderr; per-engine emissions equal their preserved full-first receipts. Primary six rejection controls and five actual oracle state faults pass. Ten optimized external corruptions reject; registered replay,24 committed bytes/modes/declared canonical-base history, official export integrity and four read-only Git-free/empty-PATH replays pass unchanged. Public head `e5505f745925f5d62340380c7b9b96dc12dd10a2` has tested/exported tree `ffd1d95226cf9c8ac57f977e8d226061d5567d86`. Eleven exact source objects authenticate before use. The primary compiles only the seven declared runtime source programs from those same bytes in private import tables. No predecessor scientific verifier/census is imported or replayed. Both hosted jobs passed at this exact head in [run41583579152](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41583579152):711 helper tests and the registered package replay. Completed logs were read once; run metadata matches the head and the synthetic test tree equals the public/tested/exported tree. No actual merge.

Reproduce with CPython3.12 standard library: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/marked-countdown-direct-return`. Direct complete runs take roughly1–5s here; no timing/speedup gate. Source logical reads/writes/unit moves do not separately price every Python/finite-control branch, managed allocation or physical machine compiler.

Task replay-runtime/a76657a85478d269d19f explicitly changes to logical tape traffic. [Finding/handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19367016). Local scope/claim preceded execution; a stale browser binding delayed public posting, which was honestly posted as a progress finding after recovery, not a retrospective advance reservation. Science finished before05:18:43UTC; the final quarter is verification/handoff. Main7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, priority8, selected6030 and all eight guidance pins unchanged.496open PRs plus fresh100latest/source6495head/feedback, targeted all-state return queries and currentHub checked. PR3611 uses a different left-origin/top-digit ABI. Sparse history, arbitrary diffs and hidden/unpublished work remain unknown.

Credit Nick Petalas6495 cached terminator/conformance; Arham Tahir2877 complete invoices; David Arias2753 linear sign; Jose Manuel2697 Counter/tape; related3611 and all retained notices. New branch/proof/checks by ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI implementation/static review, Apache-2.0. No human or formal-kernel acceptance.

All five selected assumptions remain; maintainer edits and auto-merge disabled, no merge or frontier change. No continuation scope is reserved.
